status.description: draft means content is saved but is NOT being marked. reopened means a grader opened another attempt, so an earlier attempt was handed in. unknown means the site reported a state this build does not recognise; it is deliberately not folded into one of the others.

handed_in.description: True only when Moodle reports the work as submitted. This is the question most callers are actually asking.

grading_status.description: Moodle's own word, passed through unchanged

files.description: What Moodle actually holds, so a caller can check that what was received is what they meant to send

extension_due_date.description: This account's own extension, null when none was granted. Granted per person, so the assignment's cut-off may have passed while this account may still submit.

group_submission.description: True when this is a group's submission, so handed_in describes the group's work and not this account's.

members_still_to_submit.description: Group members the site says have yet to submit. Zero also covers an assignment that does not require every member to, so it is not proof the group has finished.

earlier_attempts.description: What this account handed in before a grader reopened the assignment, oldest first. Never null; empty means the assignment was never reopened.

number.description: Moodle's own attempt number, counting from zero.

timer_ends_at.description: When a started time limit runs out, null when none is running. Not a deadline: Moodle accepts work afterwards and marks it as over time; the cut-off closes submission.

online_submission.description: False for an offline assignment: every submission plugin is switched off and the work is marked from somewhere else — a normal setting, not a fault. Null when the route that answered cannot see the setting.

path.description: Folder within the file area, "/" at the top; two files in one area can share a name in different folders

url.description: Fetch it with `moodle file download`, which attaches the credential only for this site

external.description: Held by another service, such as a linked cloud drive; the site's own token does not necessarily open it
